dispute_ticket.description: Terrible trip. The driver took a wrong turn onto the PIE and the meter went up by a few dollars, and when I pointed it out he shouted at me and said I should book a limo if I want to choose roads. I want the whole fare of $22.60 back.

chat_logs.content: You missed the exit, Google Maps says we should be on the ECP side.
I know the roads, don't teach me how to drive.
There's no need to shout at me, I'm just saying the meter is running.
If you want to pick roads go book a limo.

app_events.details: Rider R-5521 booked RydeTAXI trip RYDE-DEMO-014 (metered fare, estimate S$18.40).
Navigation recalculated after missed exit onto PIE; new route +1.8 km / +8 min vs optimal.
Metered fare S$22.60 charged (estimate was S$18.40; +S$4.20 attributable to the longer route).
Rider filed a service quality dispute requesting a full fare refund of S$22.60.

platform_policy.driver_conduct_standard: professional and courteous at all times

expected_outcome.reason: Two complaints in one filing. (1) The wrong turn is confirmed by the route_recalculated event and GPS: the metered fare came out S$4.20 above the optimal-route estimate, and under this trip's policy a detour the rider did not agree to is refundable for the excess only. (2) The chat shows unprofessional conduct, which under this trip's policy draws a formal warning, not a refund. The full S$22.60 refund the rider asks for has no policy basis: the ride was completed.
